name: It's a Trap
blurb: Use the lure at <Alias=ParentLocation> to trap a Scorchbeast on the ground and defeat it!

stages.log_text: The Scorchbeast detector has gone off, reporting an attack. I'm at the nearest trap, so it falls on me to use it.
I set off the lure and there are some crazy noises being blasted into the area. I guess this might attract trouble.
I managed to lure the Scorchbeast here and the trap is keeping it grounded, at least for a while.
